items.title: 67750_Sippie Wallace oral history interview
items.q: So Willie asked me would I go to London... So then they had Willie to come and interview me from Chicago... He say, 'Now, I want some'

ctx.x: And so they ___ Victoria no more, Victoria told them, say, "But I can send you somebody that can make your show go." So ___ Dixon was the one booking the blues singers, you know. So Lenny and (unintelligible) I was going to a rehearsal at choir that night. I had another ___ I was playing right around the corner from me and I say, "Well, Vicki," I say, "you don't want to go to church with me." I say, "You stay here until I

come back, because I'm going to rehearse the choir for an hour." I said, "Just stay here and I'll be back." It was right around the corner. It wasn't over here, it was on Marshall Street, it was over on the East side. So Lenny say, "Hot dog, what you know? I'm going to call Willie and tell Willie we have found Sippie." They had been looking for me and looking for me. So they called long distance. He said, "Sippie, can I use your telephone?" I said, "Yeah." So he used my -- on a Sunday night -- so he used my…
